rows.ls_reading: The Office holds authorship for human authors and decides, claim by claim, how much of a work a human made, requiring the AI-generated part to be disclaimed; the saved page records its decisions by the work's title and says nothing on the name an author chooses. The archive reads it as the legal register of #940's civil-name regime (copyright attaching to legal names) and as the boundary where machine participation is attributed by subtraction: the machine's part is disclaimed and the human remainder is registered as the work's authorship. #195 (The Double Enclosure), the archive's paper on the requirement, reads registration practice as a test of control and predictability, under which a prompt whose output the machine makes unpredictable is classed as an unprotectable instruction or idea and authorship does not pass through; it reads Thaler v. Perlmutter as settling only what it litigated, a claim that disclaimed human input, and leaves contested how much human involvement suffices; it names the coupling of disclosure to forfeiture a confession protocol and forecasts concealment; and it proposes a Compositional Authorship Standard and attribution without disclaimer, a contributor record of the machine systems and named instances in the registration record.

self_description.quote: Human Authored is a project of the Authors Guild that allows an author to certify that their book is created by a human.

definition.quote: “Human Authored” means that the text of the book was written by a human and not generated by AI, with the exception of minimal uses such as AI applications that check spelling and grammar or for research.

coverage.quote: Human Authored certification is available to all authors with books published in the United States who agree to the licensing terms.

membership.quote: Membership is not required but the $10/title fee and identity verification requirement are waived for Authors Guild members.

database.quote: Human Authored certifications are listed in a public database where anyone can verify a book’s human origins. You can search for a title, authors, or Human Authored registration number to see and confirm the certification details.

requirements.quote: Identity Verification Not required Required Cost Free! (included in dues) $10/title

identity.quote: You will have to verify your identity through a third-party service and pay a $10/title registration fee.

tagline.quote: Distinguish human creativity in an increasingly AI world.

expanded.quote: Announcement of the expanded Human Authored program

mark.quote: Usage guidelines for the Human Author certification mark

faq_definition.quote: “Human Authored” means that the text of the work was fully authored by one or more human beings and not generated by GAI, except that a de minimis (e.g., very small or trifling) amount of text may be generated or modified by or with the use of generative AI, e.g., through the use of AI-powered spelling and grammar check applications or to create indices.

faq_de_minimis.quote: We mirror the U.S. Copyright Office’s guidance in this respect; more than a de minimis amount of AI-generated text must be excluded from a copyright application and makes a work ineligible for Human Authored certification.

guidelines_definition.quote: The certification mark may only be used in connection with literary works for which the text itself was fully authored by one or more human beings and not generated by AI, except for a de minimis amount (such as through the use of AI-powered spelling and grammar check applications).

guidelines_mark.quote: The mark, illustrated below, consists of the words Human Authored in a circle around a human silhouette.
